AI photo trend transforms Indian politicians into 1980s Bollywood stars

A viral artificial intelligence trend is transforming photos of Indian politicians into images resembling 1980s Bollywood heroes. The trend, which involves using AI prompts to generate pictures in the style of that era, has gained significant traction on social media. Prominent figures, including ministers and former deputy chief ministers from Bihar, have been depicted in these stylized photographs, often evoking the 'angry young man' persona popular in early Indian cinema. The AI-generated images are being widely shared online.
